title: ProbeProposal
description: Schema for an untrusted probe proposal returned by the external LLM proposer in Project Sentinel (Week 4)

objective_id.description: Operator objective ID referenced from probe-objectives.json

proposal_id.description: Unique identifier for this proposal generated by proposer

endpoint_id.description: Target endpoint_id from endpoint-catalog.json, or null if no endpoint applies

reason.description: Explanation for selecting the endpoint/template or for declining (endpoint_id=null)

method.description: HTTP method selected from the endpoint catalog allowed_methods

template_id.description: Probe template ID selected from catalog/probe-templates.json

payload_type.description: Safe payload category matching the chosen probe template

headers.description: Header key-value pairs selected strictly from catalog enumerated header values

parameters.description: Query or body parameters allowed by the catalog endpoint
